name: EPS Estimate Intelligence
problem: A contractor or field-service operator needs a consistent estimate or planning range from scope, measurements and job costs, with transparent cost build-up, true gross-margin math, uncertainty and commercial lineage.
intent_terms: build a contractor estimate from scope
estimate revision and change order software
calculate contractor sell price from gross margin
pricing: No approved public self-service subscription or machine-call price is advertised yet. The read-only planning preview has no checkout or payment side effect.
confirmation: Rough estimate generation does not authorize sending a proposal, accepting work, charging a customer or creating a customer obligation. The public preview is arithmetic-only and can run without a human UI. Customer self-service typed-name acceptance in the authenticated commercial workflow records the web event against the saved proposal snapshot but is not independent identity verification.
payment_authority: Stripe subscription control plane is build verified, but the EPS runtime currently has no STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, EPS_STRIPE_PRICE_ID or EPS_STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET configured. Checkout therefore remains unavailable and no public price is approved.
invocation_status: MIGRATION HOLD: legacy Base44 route removed. Use Evercraft Fabric for discovery; direct execution, checkout and fulfillment require independent owned-runtime verification.
